title: What’s in a name?
html_source:
Juliet:

O, be some other name!
What’s in a name? That which we call a rose
By any other name would smell as sweet

Romeo and Juliet, Act 2, Scene 2

anchor.prefix: ounds are impostures, Stephen said after a pause of some little time, like names. Cicero, Podmore, Napoleon, Mr Goodbody, Jesus, Mr Doyle. Shakespeares were as common as Murphies.
